subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: Should the Trim OS packaged Gateway auth/config regeneration be handled as an OpenClaw core Gateway repair, a package-owner follow-up, or left open until logs identify the failing protocol frame?
rationale: The reported workaround and possible fixes touch Gateway device pairing and shared-auth boundaries, and the repo does not contain the Trim OS package manager that allegedly rewrites config.

options.title: Collect proof before changing auth
options.body: Ask for redacted `--ws-log full`/gateway logs, the connect protocol range, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and the generated config before choosing a code or package fix.

options.title: Core diagnostic/docs repair
options.body: If the logs show a current OpenClaw client speaking the wrong protocol or opaque diagnostics, fix the Gateway/CLI diagnostic path without loosening pairing.

options.title: Route to package owner
options.body: If the only reproducible issue is `trim.openclaw` regenerating config outside this tree, keep core secure and route the config-management change to the package owner.

recommendation.title: Collect proof before changing auth
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted `--ws-log full`/gateway logs, the connect protocol range, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and the generated config before choosing a code or package fix.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across gateway protocol compatibility, device approval docs, and package/release-adjacent gateway behavior.
